title: Encoded Step Relation Agreement
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s$ be a natural number. The relation obtained by querying the machine’s step-decider oracle on the encoded input consisting of $x$, the binary representations of two configuration codes, and $s$ agrees with the step relation defined by membership of that same encoding in the machine’s step language.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
